San Francisco Premium Outlets 在东湾 Liverm: San Francisco Premium Outlets is in Livermore in the East Bay, not in San Francisco. Great Mall is in Milpitas and combines indoor outlet and value retail; the word “mall” does not make it equivalent to a regular full-price shopping center.

无车或行程很短：先选住处附近能到达的购物区。旧金山可考虑 Union Squar: Without a car or with limited time, choose an accessible area near your accommodation. In San Francisco, consider Union Square, Japan Center, or Stonestown; include transfers and the return journey when considering distant outlets.

游客、新居民和老居民，各自怎么选: How visitors, newcomers, and residents can choose
来玩的人：先核对目标品牌是否有店，再决定是否值得占用半天。返程航班当天尽量不安排: Visitors: verify that your target brands have stores before allocating half a day. Avoid distant shopping on your flight day where possible; consider luggage space, warranty region, and whether a return would require another visit.
刚搬来的人：先分衣物、家居、电子用品和日用品四张清单。商场目录只能证明有这家店，: Newcomers: separate clothing, home goods, electronics, and everyday essentials. A directory listing does not establish stock for a model or large item. Check pickup, delivery, and dimensions online before visiting.
住很久的人：先处理退换货、维修或补货，再安排想逛的新店。跨湾前比较同品牌线上价格: Established residents: handle returns, repairs, or replenishment first, then browse new stores. Compare online prices and nearby branches before crossing the Bay; combining a meal, pickup, and a convenient trip can save more than visiting another center.
半天怎么安排：六种实用组合: Six practical ways to spend half a day
南湾试穿＋晚餐：Valley Fair 先办目标采购，再到 Santana Ro: South Bay shopping and dinner: complete target purchases at Valley Fair, then browse and eat at Santana Row. Check each center’s parking terms separately; do not assume one parking benefit covers both.
雨天集中购物：Great Mall，或按住处选 Stonestown、Hills: Concentrated shopping on a rainy day: choose Great Mall or a convenient primarily indoor center such as Stonestown, Hillsdale, or Stoneridge. Some stores may use outside entrances, so consult the map.
半岛轻松半日：以 Stanford Shopping Center 为主，若还有: An easy Peninsula half-day: focus on Stanford Shopping Center, adding Town & Country Village only if you have time and energy. For a specific purchase, one may be enough.
旧金山无车逛街：Union Square 按目标店串起来；喜欢日式杂货、书籍和餐: Car-free shopping in San Francisco: link target stores around Union Square, or choose Japan Center for Japanese goods, books, and food. Check transit that day and allow time for food queues and the return trip.
东湾 Outlet 专程：以 Livermore 的 San Francisco: An East Bay outlet trip: make San Francisco Premium Outlets in Livermore the main shopping stop. Avoid squeezing in San Francisco sightseeing or Napa on the same day; return when your list is complete.
北湾露天购物：The Village 与 Town Center Corte M: North Bay open-air shopping: choose between The Village and Town Center Corte Madera for different browsing styles. For outlet brands, pick Petaluma, Napa, or Vacaville according to the trip you already planned.
省钱不是只看几折: Compare the real cost, not just the discount sign
FTC 提醒，部分 Outlet 商品是专供款，材质、细节或型号未必与正价店相同: The FTC notes that some outlet products are made specifically for outlets, with materials, details, or models that may differ from regular stores; regular stores may not accept outlet returns. Compare actual prices for the same item or specifications, and ask where and when returns are accepted.
出发前保存目标款号和品牌官网价格；现场看材质、尺寸、做工与保修，而不是仅看吊牌上: Save target model numbers and brand-site prices before leaving. Inspect material, fit, construction, and warranty rather than relying only on a “Compare At” or crossed-out price.
先看商场与品牌的官方 Offers／Deals 页面；优惠券、会员、App 或学: Check official center and brand Offers or Deals pages. Read the current terms for fees, participating stores, and stacking before using coupons, memberships, apps, or student offers.
把含税商品价、停车、油费或车票、过桥及额外行李费用合在一起估算。省下十几元却多跑: Estimate the total of the after-tax item price, parking, fuel or transit, tolls, and any extra baggage. Saving a small amount may not justify several additional hours.
先确认 Final Sale、退回原支付方式还是店内余额、线上订单能否店内退，以: Confirm final-sale status, refund method versus store credit, in-store returns for online orders, and warranty terms for discounted or outlet-specific items. Keep receipts and tags until you decide to keep the purchase.
官方消费指引：识别 Outlet 商品与参考价: Official consumer guidance: outlet merchandise and reference prices
付款前核对款号、材质、实际价格和退货规则；疑问先向店员确认。: Check model numbers, materials, actual prices, and return rules before paying; ask store staff about anything unclear.
在当天官网核对目标店铺、店铺自己的营业时间与库存；不要只看整个中心的开门时间。: Check target stores, their own hours, and stock on official sites that day, not just the center’s opening time.
查普通停车、停车验证、代客泊车和电动车充电各自的费用及限制，保存停车区或车位位置: Check separate terms for self-parking, validation, valet, and EV charging, and save the parking area or space location.
带孩子或长辈时，先查洗手间、母婴室、休息区和无障碍入口；需要轮椅或婴儿车时先问服: With children or older adults, locate restrooms, family facilities, seating, and accessible entrances; ask guest services in advance about wheelchairs or strollers.
露天中心准备防晒或外套；步行距离与购物袋重量一起考虑，按需要安排休息。: For open-air centers, bring sun protection or a layer; consider both walking distance and bag weight, and plan breaks.
无车出行同时查最后一段接驳、返程班次与大件携带条件；自驾按停车规则停放，随身带走: Without a car, check the last transfer, return service, and rules for carrying bulky items. When driving, follow posted parking rules and take documents and valuables with you.
付款前再次核对最终价格、退换货条件、收据和提货方式；需要配送时确认日期、费用与谁: Before paying, reconfirm final price, returns, receipt, and pickup method. For delivery, confirm the date, charges, and who will receive it.
问店员：库存、优惠与退货: Ask the store about stock, offers, and returns
